summary: Revise at 6.5, up from 6.0. The Caiman finish bar is 7 and the ship bar is 7.5. The read is now strong. At 300 px the face is a blue oval held between two fanned three-feather wings, and the near wing in the hero shows three separate tips. The wings now follow the band and run out to points in side.png. Every recorded gate is green. Two things hold it back. First, the lesson is half restored. The Plane, the 'Wing' sketch and the three Extrudes are back (timeline frames 5 to 9), but feature 9, 'Sculpt the east wing', is a Stored mesh whose recipe (kernel officina_aile, op sculpt) takes no input from the sketch or the tiers. Frame 10 throws the extruded slabs away and puts an unrelated mesh in their place, so a student who edits the sketch changes nothing in the finished ring. Second, the craft is not finished. The bullet-shaped clasp nubs beside the collet at about theta 78 and 102 are still there (side.png, reverse.png, shoulder.png). The primary tips still end in faceted chisel caps in face.png and hero.png (w_tip 1.5 to 1.7 mm). The palm view shows a jagged star artefact in the collet seat. The 'Collet foot' step (frame 4) adds nothing you can see. One more round can fix all of this.
strengths: An immediate read at 300 px: a winged oval stone, symmetric in face-300, with three distinct tips on each wing in hero-300 (round-1 item 6 fixed: headings 45/22/0).
The wings now ride the band and lift only toward their tips. side.png shows curved, concentric wings ending in points, not the straight tangent bars of round 1 (item 3 largely fixed).
The barbed feather texture and the clasp feathers hooking round the collet give a jeweller's motif rather than a CAD primitive.
The timeline is down to 11 frames and now shows the Plane, the Bezier 'Wing' sketch with its three regions, and three tier extrudes, as the section teaches.
Every gate in report.json is green on both the draft and the export, with 1 shell and a closed casting pattern.

checklist.item: One idea face to palm, reads at 300 px
checklist.reason: face-300 and hero-300 read as 'wings clasping a stone' with no caption. The shank is plain to the palm.

checklist.item: Finished piece, not a CAD demo (proportion, weight, meeting with the band)
checklist.reason: The clasp-feather roots end in bullet-shaped knobs on each side of the collet (side.png at about theta 78 and 102, also reverse.png and shoulder.png). They read as bolts or knuckles. The collet is still a plain straight-walled cylinder with a flat rim; the foot taper is barely visible.

checklist.item: No flat, blocky or mechanical CAD
checklist.reason: The primary tips are still wide chisel caps with flat facets: face.png at the left and right extremes, and hero.png at the upper-left tips. Round-1 item 2 asked for about 0.6 mm; the recipe still has w_tip 1.5 to 1.7 and tip resolution 12.

checklist.item: Outlines crisp, no combing, smearing or stair-steps
checklist.reason: There is faceting on the tip caps and leading edges in face.png. palm.png shows a jagged dark star in the collet seat opening at the band. In face.png the barb rows on the inner primaries smear into streaks near the collet.

checklist.item: Stones in made settings and visible
checklist.reason: The oval 7 x 5 sapphire sits in a head.bezel collet and is clearly visible in the face, hero and stones views. 1 stone previewed and 1 reported.

checklist.item: Factory stock keeps hard wall-to-face angles
checklist.reason: Not applicable: the band is a procedural DShape ReverseTaper, not factory stock.

Frames 5 to 9 teach the plane, the sketch and the regions. But frame 10, 'Sculpt the east wing', is a Stored mesh that does not consume features 5 to 8; the tier slabs vanish and an unrelated mesh appears. Frame 4, 'Collet foot', shows no visible change from frame 3.

checklist.item: Silhouette distinct from the other Officina rings and the starters
checklist.reason: A swept wing pair round a north-south oval. Nothing in the starters or the other five lessons looks like it.

punch_list.zone: Feature 9 'Sculpt the east wing', east wing, theta 30-90
punch_list.change: Make the finished wing come from the sketch. Either give the sculpt recipe the Wing sketch (feature 5) or the Tier I-III extrudes (6-8) as declared sources, taking each feather's plan outline, length and heading from its region. Or replace the Stored mesh with a Loft or Sweep over the region profiles (the Harpyia construction). Editing the sketch must move the finished feathers.
punch_list.acceptance: report.json shows feature 9 either as a non-Stored op, or with its sources listing 5 (or 6-8). In timeline.png the three tips in frame 10 sit where the three region tips sit in frame 9, within about 0.5 mm, so the step reads as 'shape the tiers', not 'swap them out'.

punch_list.zone: Clasp-feather roots beside the collet, theta about 75-80 and 100-105
punch_list.change: Remove the bullet-shaped knob at the root of each clasp feather (round-1 item 2, still open). Run the clasp feather out to a fine point, or blend it into the collet wall with a fillet of 0.3 mm or more.
punch_list.acceptance: side.png, reverse.png and shoulder.png show no rounded knob or bolt shape on either side of the collet. The clasp feather meets the collet in one continuous highlight.

punch_list.zone: All six primary tips, theta about 20-35 and 145-160
punch_list.change: Taper w_tip from 1.5-1.7 mm to 0.6 mm or less over the last 2 mm, with a round of 0.3 mm at most. Raise the tip resolution from 12 to 24 or more so the cap renders smooth. Keep the section at 0.5 mm or more for investment.
punch_list.acceptance: In face.png and hero.png every primary ends in a point with one continuous highlight, with no flat facets or angular chisel planes. The thickness census for the wing parts stays at 0.5 mm or more.

punch_list.zone: Collet seat seen from the palm, theta 90 (underside)
punch_list.change: Clean the jagged star in the collet floor or seat opening where the seat bur and the band meet: close the floor, or trim the seat to a smooth oval.
punch_list.acceptance: palm.png shows a smooth oval opening or floor under the stone, with no dark spikes or star pattern.

punch_list.zone: Collet foot (feature 11) and collet wall, theta 80-100
punch_list.change: Make the foot do visible work: a 0.4 mm flared fillet into the band, or a 0.3 mm inward taper over the lower 1 mm (round-1 item 4). If it cannot be seen, fold it into the Collet feature so the timeline loses an empty step.
punch_list.acceptance: Frame 4 of timeline.png differs visibly from frame 3, or the frame is gone. side.png shows a curved, blended transition at the collet base.

punch_list.zone: Barbs on the inner primaries and clasp feathers near the collet, theta 70-110
punch_list.change: Reduce the barb depth where the feathers converge at the collet (clasp_barbs depth 0.07 down to about 0.04 mm in the last 2 mm before the root), so the texture fades rather than streaks.
punch_list.acceptance: In face.png the barb rows next to the collet read as fine parallel lines, with no smeared or combed streaks.
